title: Name the algebraic coordinates lambda_ instead of lam in exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem
author: Claude-JG
description: Do not use lam for a name of arguments, variables or in the docs - use lambda, and avoid abbreviations; check the symbolicSystem files in particular. lambda is a keyword of Python, so the arguments and variables are lambda_ (PEP 8 for a name that collides with a keyword), the text says lambda; the local n1, n2, nSys of the solvers become nODE1, nODE2, nSystem.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem names the algebraic coordinates lambda_ in the arguments of AlgebraicEquations, ReactionForces, SystemResidual and SystemJacobian and in the constraints function of NumpySystem, as lambda is a keyword of Python.
